title: U-Net Mars O2+ Beams: inference code and trained model
description:
U-Net v12 count2 inference software and trained weights for identification of energetic O2+ beams and low-energy ions in MAVEN STATIC C6 spectra. Three inputs are normalized O2+ log DEF, a strict two-count-equivalent validity mask, and normalized log energy. Inference uses 512 x 32 windows, stride 51, and mean overlapping softmax probabilities before argmax. The source training stride is 256.

This version includes the background-corrected 20 January 2018 C6 example with native raw counts, background-subtracted counts, corrected DEF, calibrated two-count thresholds, reproducible current-model predictions and figures, and complete standalone installation instructions. It also includes updated input and architecture figures. The full-day example was verified in a clean Python environment without personal helper libraries.
